evidence_cards.content: Critical alarms shall be generated when one or more of these conditions are met: A closure device changes from a known state to unknown state (status lost); A closure device changes from legal state to illegal state; The control system Integrity verification indicates a verification failure; When a user logs in any of the field units; When a command to override a device has been issued anywhere in the system; When there is a communication failure within the RLCS network; When a computer in the RLCS network goes down; Power failure at any controller or workstation; When a cabinet ID is changed; When the DCUs are in manual mode; Watch Dog timer failure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Lists the specific system states that trigger critical alerts during the monitoring process.

evidence_cards.content: Warning alarms shall be generated when one or more of these conditions are met: security sensor activation at either the FCU or DCU; When Air pressure, Temperature in cabinets, and Voltages are outside the limits of established thresholds as stored in the database.
